ranked_facts.why: The new onset 2/6 holosystolic murmur is more likely to be associated with infective endocarditis, as it suggests valve involvement, which is a hallmark of this condition. In contrast, non-infective endocarditis and cardiac valve disorder may not necessarily present with a new murmur, and systemic infection or other conditions are less likely to cause this specific finding.

ranked_facts.concept_key: past medical history of valve replacement
ranked_facts.why: A past medical history of mitral valve replacement increases the risk of infective endocarditis, as prosthetic valves are more susceptible to infection. This fact is less likely to be associated with non-infective endocarditis, cardiac valve disorder, systemic infection, or other conditions.
